findings.title: P2: Complete the Prism path with exact configured workload identities
findings.body: COM-003 remains incomplete: the topology, matrix and restart section name workload roles but never give the exact SPIFFE identities or their configuration derivation. Operators cannot use this central path to distinguish a wrong namespace/ServiceAccount from an operation-binding failure. HEAD defines exact SANs in charts/prism/templates/configmap-worker-trust.yaml:31-35,86,107,128 and selects trust-domain/agent settings in my-values/prism-values.yaml:35-40 and my-values/nova-values.yaml:118-121. Document those identity templates and the selected configuration alongside each authenticated hop, without claiming live identity issuance. The new restart coverage does not discharge this original identity obligation.

findings.title: P2: Include native storage and output pressure in the connection contract
findings.body: COM-012 still lacks actionable native pressure rules. The matrix mentions generic input/cgroup budgets, while the additions describe recovery and isolation limits without documenting native journal admission capacity or aggregate process-output overflow. HEAD skills/prism/config/native-worker.ts:73-81 defines separate ownership, input, output, journal, drain and close limits, including 32 MiB output and 64 GiB journal defaults. skills/worker/core/worker/native-attempt-journal.ts:169 reserves input plus maximum output/result space before admission; native-process-output.ts:12 stops the process with WORKER_NATIVE_OUTPUT_LIMIT. These are different from the documented 16 MiB result-artifact and 128 MiB evidence limits. Add the effective configuration sources and explain which limits reject admission, terminate the producer, or fence subsequent work; otherwise an operator cannot diagnose or safely resolve these pressure failures from the promised central matrix.

overall_explanation:
COM-003 NOT_READY: restart/result reconciliation is substantially covered, but exact configured hop identities remain absent (finding 1). COM-004 PASS: Gateway envelope, current review protocols, correlation, polling, result-import selection and unresolved cleanup match the inspected runtime-dispatch source. COM-005 PASS: invocation/result/effect/observer summaries, NDJSON isolation, cancellation, termination and error mapping match the inspected contracts and Core implementation. COM-012 NOT_READY: native admission/storage/output pressure remains incomplete (finding 2); the new observer and isolation coverage does not satisfy the whole per-connection obligation.

sourceAccuracy: PASS for the inspected additions against current source, with no live execution inferred. readerUsability: NOT_READY for the missing identity and pressure diagnosis information. quality: NOT_READY for whole-obligation completeness. Observer restart and isolation tests were inspected as source only; no tests, product, rendering or cluster execution was performed.

Prior accepted scopes: COM-002 impact PASS; COM-006 impact PASS; COM-007 impact PASS. The additions and metadata do not materially contradict or weaken those accepted facets. COM-001/008/009/010/011 remain open and are not accepted by this review. Native runtime/effect execution and unknown external identities remain unproven.
